selection_rationale: AC-2026-03 (validator-metric suite) best balances novelty, falsifiability, reproducibility, and feasibility for the CNSM Agentic AI Researcher track: reviewers rated it highest (verdict: pass) and its scope directly addresses measurable gaps (validator metrics and predictive power) supported by prior work (see records below). It avoids disallowed human-in-the-loop steps in the manifest and produces reusable artifacts suited to a five-page short paper and NotebookLM brief.
unresolved_uncertainties: Representativeness of seeded fault taxonomy for real operational errors and impact on external validity.
Sensitivity of detection-latency metrics to infrastructure timing variability.
Robustness of conclusions to alternative cost-model parameterizations for simulated operational impact.
Degree to which validator-metric correlations predict real production end-to-end success (vs. simulated proxies).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Preregister the operational-impact cost-model mapping (cost units per error class) and include planned sensitivity analyses over plausible parameter ranges.
Openly publish the seeded-fault taxonomy, example seeded cases, and justification of representativeness; bound claims to the seeded taxonomy if necessary.

Specify and preregister a synchronized timing methodology for detection-latency measurement (timing sources, synchronization procedure, repeated measures) and include planned repeated runs to estimate infrastructure variance.
Prepare and commit to releasing metric-computation code, scoring scripts, and example datasets (seeded outputs and validator logs) alongside the paper for reproducibility.
